dslRule:
<!id: stringbuffer.to.stringbuilder.local>
<!description: Replace new StringBuffer() with new StringBuilder() when assigned to a local variable for performance, as StringBuilder is not synchronized and StringBuffer is rarely needed for local, unshared instances.>
<!severity: INFO>
new java.lang.StringBuffer($args$) :: isAssignedToLocalVariable()
=> new java.lang.StringBuilder($args$)
;;
